tool_input.command:
mkdir -p .tmp submission
> .tmp/vectors.txt
while IFS= read -r key; do
  key=$(echo "$key" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$key" ] && continue
  out=$(hops --json fv get profiles7437b0_fv --version 1 --entry "account_id=$key" 2>/dev/null)
  # extract the 4 numeric vector elements (account_id line is quoted, floats are not)
  floats=$(echo "$out" | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?,?[[:space:]]*$' | tr -d ' ,')
  vals=$(echo "$floats" | paste -sd' ' -)
  echo "$key $vals" >> .tmp/vectors.txt
done < data/lookup_keys.txt
cat .tmp/vectors.txt
echo "---count---"
wc -l .tmp/vectors.txt
